23: And even where there is no complete testimony in the matter, etc.: even without warning. Responsum of the Ramban, siman 279, cited in the Sma. And for capital cases they must be cautioned to act with the agreement of the elders of the city, so that they act after great need and with deliberation. Beis Yosef in the name of the Rashba, of blessed memory; and so wrote the Sma.
